answer: Give every new agent a ferrous audit trail: its kernel identity starts inside a narrow canyon of rate-limited permissions, able to perform only low-value tasks. Each completed job is verified by independent peers and recorded on-ledger, slowly widening its trust. Creating a fresh identity resets that history to zero, so a Sybil must redo costly, time-consuming work for each fake account, while honest agents keep compounding reputation that decays if unused.
